notes.title: Controller Update
notes.notes:
Introducing the controller update. And few other stuff.


Controller mode option available in game settings. This option only changes the visual tutorials/tips/hints in the game. Means you can play the game both on keyboard+mouse and controller without changing any setting.
Crosshair sensivity slider available in game settings. This option only changes the speed on controllers.
David seemed like little clunky character, so now he has a bullet time when he switches to his gun in air. It's really cool.
Also Jason has it on his leap but it's just to slow him down a little and it's not that huge change compared to David.
Few level updates: enemy positions, lightning,


Right now I will be working on secret levels and better demo.
Thank you.
